name: Lua
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Runs a Lua app, such as a Discord bot, on Luvit from your files or a Git repository. Packages from package.lua are installed with lit when it changes.
startup: if [ -d .git ] && [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = "1" ]; then git pull --ff-only || echo "git pull failed: starting what is here"; fi; h=$(cat package.lua 2>/dev/null; echo "{{LIT_PACKAGES}}"); h=$(echo "$h" | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat deps/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then if [ -f package.lua ]; then ./lit install || exit 1; fi; if [ -n "{{LIT_PACKAGES}}" ]; then ./lit install {{LIT_PACKAGES}} || exit 1; fi; mkdir -p deps && echo "$h" > deps/.raptor-installed; fi; exec ./luvit "{{LUA_FILE}}" {{LUA_ARGS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Lua: clones the app's Git repository, if one is set. Files already in
# the server's folder are never deleted or overwritten.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

clone() {
    if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then
        echo "No Git repository set: upload your app's files, then start the server."
        return 0
    fi
    local url="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
    case "$url" in *.git) ;; *) url="$url.git" ;; esac
    if [ -n "${GIT_USERNAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
        url="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_TOKEN}@${url#https://}"
    fi
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo "The repository is already here: pulling the latest changes."
        git pull --ff-only
    elif [ -n "$(ls -A)" ]; then
        echo "The folder already has files and isn't a Git repository, so nothing was cloned."
    else
        GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git clone --depth 1 ${GIT_BRANCH:+--branch "$GIT_BRANCH"} "$url" . || {
            echo "The repository couldn't be cloned: check its address, and the username and access token for a private one."
            exit 1
        }
    fi
}

clone

# Luvit: luvi (the runtime) from its GitHub releases, then lit and luvit
# built with it from lit.luvit.io, as luvit's own get-lit.sh does.
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
versions=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://lit.luvit.io/packages/luvit/luvit) || { echo "Luvit's package list couldn't be fetched."; exit 1; }
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    want=$(jq -r 'keys[]' <<<"$versions" | sort -V | tail -n 1)
elif ! jq -e --arg v "$want" 'has($v)' <<<"$versions" >/dev/null; then
    echo "Luvit ${want} doesn't exist: see https://lit.luvit.io/packages/luvit/luvit for the versions."
    exit 1
fi
if [ -x luvit ] && [ "$(./luvit --version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" = "luvit version: ${want}" ]; then
    echo "Luvit ${want} is already installed."
else
    case "$(uname -m)" in
        x86_64) arch=x86_64 ;;
        aarch64|arm64) arch=aarch64 ;;
        *) echo "Luvit has no build for $(uname -m)."; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    luvi=$(gh-release tag luvit/luvi latest) || exit 1
    lit=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://lit.luvit.io/packages/luvit/lit | jq -r 'keys[]' | sort -V | tail -n 1)
    work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
    rm -rf "$work"
    mkdir -p "$work"
    trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
    export HOME="$work"
    gh-release download luvit/luvi "$luvi" "luvi-Linux-${arch}-luajit-regular" "$work/luvi"
    chmod +x "$work/luvi"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$work/lit.zip" "https://lit.luvit.io/packages/luvit/lit/v${lit}.zip"
    (cd "$work" && ./luvi lit.zip -- make lit.zip lit luvi >/dev/null && ./lit make "lit://luvit/luvit@${want}" luvit luvi >/dev/null)
    mv -f "$work/lit" "$work/luvit" .
    export HOME=/mnt/server
    echo "Installed Luvit ${want} (luvi ${luvi#v}, lit ${lit})."
fi

variables.name: Main file
variables.description: The file that starts your app, such as app.lua.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Luvit version, such as 2.18.1, or latest.

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: An https link to the app's repository, cloned when the server is installed. Leave it empty to upload the files yourself.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: The branch to clone. Empty uses the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git username
variables.description: Your username on the Git host, for a private repository.

variables.name: Git access token
variables.description: An access token that can read the private repository.

variables.name: Pull updates at start
variables.description: Pull the repository's latest changes every time the server starts.

variables.name: Extra packages
variables.description: lit packages to install as well, separated by spaces.
